title: Proof of Delivery Authorization Form
subtitle: Proof Of Delivery: bounds the decision, conditions, and expiry.
description: Proof of Delivery Authorization Form controls delivered unit, recipient, delivery point, timestamp, condition, and privacy-conscious proof by tying each Proof Of Delivery custody, document, or movement decision to the consignee / proof authority, a stated boundary, and an expiry. The delivery verification coordinator preserves conditions, exceptions, confirmation, and both sides of the handoff.
use_case: Use Proof of Delivery Authorization Form at destination address, authorized delivery point, vehicle, and custody handoff. Check applicable Proof Of Delivery requirements, list the affected quantity, value, document, route, or custody action, and state its limit. Record whether the consignee / proof authority approves, conditions, holds, or declines the request; obtain renewed consent before changing delivered unit, recipient, delivery point, timestamp, condition, and privacy-conscious proof scope.

sections.title: Requesting party, authority, and source record
sections.guidance: For Proof Of Delivery, identify responsible parties, destination address, authorized delivery point, vehicle, and custody handoff, and the linked delivered unit, recipient, delivery point, timestamp, condition, and privacy-conscious proof source.

fields.label: Piece, package, serial, seal, and quantity
Recipient, organization, authority, and delivery-point identity

sections.title: Requested scope, limits, and decision lines
sections.guidance: Capture Proof Of Delivery facts for delivered unit, recipient, delivery point, timestamp, condition, and privacy-conscious proof; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Proof Of Delivery authorization checks
items: Signature, photograph, scan, or other permitted proof
Refusal, unattended delivery, or failed-attempt basis

sections.title: Decision evidence, expiry, and next control
sections.guidance: Resolve open Proof Of Delivery conditions; have delivery verification coordinator assign the next Proof Of Delivery owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Decision limits, holds, and retained evidence
items: Proof collection would exceed privacy policy
blocks.guidance: Pause Proof Of Delivery when recipient, location, custody, condition, or permitted proof remains unresolved. Retain the available Proof Of Delivery proof and route unresolved delivered unit, recipient, delivery point, timestamp, condition, and privacy-conscious proof scope to delivery verification coordinator.
